paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 5:11 R' Ze’irah speaks in his name; but Hyman says the reading should undoubtedly be R' Giddul, as in Korban HaEdah’s reading.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied locator is Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 5:11. The current Guggenheimer chapter 5 has eight halakhot; all 26 paragraphs of that chapter were read without finding the named Gedulah/Giddul–Ze’irah report. This is a bounded comparison, not an absence claim elsewhere or a repair of the historical locator. Korban HaEdah was not freshly collated. The heading and the two abbreviated personal titles therefore remain R'. Hyman’s “should undoubtedly read” retains its force and attribution; his proposed Giddul reading is not substituted into the Hebrew.
